text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner and into the 
straight!! A roaring crowd welcomes them!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Waltz... Cure... Lapis——)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(This Derby that I ran with everyone... I 
will never, ever forget it for the rest of 
my life...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!! And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's over...――――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Still... strangely enough, I have no 
regrets...―)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(That's how... truly... amazing of a race 
it was...――)

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble...!!" "Bubble!!" 
"Bubble-chaaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone~~!! Is it just me, or 
was that seriously the absolute best race 
everrr?!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just Lapis. It became an 
unforgettable race for me, too."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm truly happy to have run together with 
everyone today. ...Good work out there."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone. Thank you so much for the 
best race.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Did everyone hear the crowd's cheers 
after the race?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa! That was another incredible Derby! 
All of the Big Four were amazing--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That was the best Derby everーー!! I'll 
keep cheering for youーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Show us an even more incredible race--!! 
The Heavenly Kings are the beeeeeeest!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone was watching us. They were 
placing their hopes on the future of the 
Four Heavenly Kings.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn, let's drive the crowd wild 
with the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)...! We're gonna whip up an even 
bigger Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And after that—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely all run together again. 
And have an even better race than today!

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text: "Yes...!" "Yeah!" "Yup!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I couldn't keep our 
promise."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't make you... a Derby-winning 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: Still, this is the absolute best feeling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Nippon Derby, Bubble Gum Fellow 
made me feel more thrilled than anyone 
else ever had.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will surely never forget that she ran 
today's race, nor the brave sight of her 
competing, for as long as I live.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just that... was the greatest feeling I 
could have as a Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What a pain...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's a bit of a foul play—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow's "Japanese 
Derby" came to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Bubble Gum Fellow was being interviewed 
alongside the other members of the Big 
Four.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—To the Four Heavenly Kings who've lit up 
the Classic Year: will all of you be 
targeting the Kikuka Sho this autumn?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Holy Cure, Sol Lapis, and I all 
intend to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh— Is Bubble Gum Fellow currently not 
planning to run in the Kikuka Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will not be running in the Kikuka 
Sho. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I will run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? T-That's...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—And I will win. Definitely. So please, 
look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To the future success of us, the Four 
Heavenly Kings!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This interview spread among race fans in 
an instant—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see this!? Sounds like 
Bubble's aiming for the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right after last year's Satsuki Sho 
Umamusume?! Does Bubble have a real shot 
at this...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! The Four Heavenly Kings won't all 
be together for the Kikuka Sho? The 
Japanese Derby was so intense, I was 
really looking forward to it, but—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! When they've got a 
manga-like backstory like 'childhood 
friends from the same club', you can't 
help but hope they race together!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it like... it's only the Big Four 
when all four are together? Well, but if 
Bubble actually wins this, it'll 
definitely hype things up either way!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan E
text_block_list.text:
No, but seriously, like... don't you feel 
like the Senior division is even more 
stacked this year compared to last...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan F
text_block_list.text:
Totally! I mean, the girls who beat that 
Triple Crown Umamusume Narita Brian are 
tearing it up on the front lines!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright then, let's review, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Our rivals standing in our way at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The Tenno Sho (Autumn) that Bubble Gum 
Fellow is taking on gathers the very best 
among veteran Senior-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the most noteworthy among them is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having both experienced victory over the 
Triple Crown Umamusume Narita Brian, they 
are currently the two Umamusume with the 
greatest momentum."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Mayano Top Gun conquered the 
Arima Kinen as a Classic-class racer 
against the likes of Narita Brian, putting 
her sheer brilliance on full display.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the veteran Sakura Laurel, who 
dramatically triumphed over Narita Brian 
in a deadly duel at this year's Tenno Sho 
(Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow must fight seasoned 
veterans alongside the "strongest" 
standing at the forefront of the era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Depending on the case, some formidable 
rivals might even awaken heading into 
autumn—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm going to take on the challenge, I 
want them to be the strongest Senior Class 
in history. Because—"
choice_data_list:
—That's the best way to prove you're the 
strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. If our opponent is going to be 
formidable anyway, and the hurdle 
extremely high, then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The more brutally difficult it is, the 
more it proves a strength no one can 
dispute...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's so us, isn't it!
choice_data_list: Let's get even stronger this summer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And on to the stormy autumn!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the decisive battle at the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), a trial-filled summer 
was fast approaching—
